description:
DNA, RNA and protein sequence data analysis.


Version 27.0.1 is the first supported version in the 27 release line. Please refer to the version 27.0 release notes for information about new features and improvements introduced in this line, as well as licensing updates, other changes, and advanced notice of upcoming changes.
Bug fixes
- Fixed an issue where Extract Consensus Sequence did not produce a report when provided with an empty read mapping as input.
- Fixed an issue with zooming in the workflow editor on macs. Pressing the Cmd key while using the mouse scroll wheel now zooms the view in and out, as intended. Pressing the Ctrl key while using the mouse scroll wheel moves the view up and down, as intended.
- Fixed an issue where running multiple exports to JSON format files in parallel on the same system could cause the jobs to fail, or to complete with incorrect content.
- Vulnerabilities fixed in this release include:
